tools.description: Standalone archiver achieving maximum compression ratios through advanced LZMA2 algorithms
tools.usage:
7za a backup.7z * -mx=9 -mhe=on -p # Ultimate compression with encryption
7za l -slt archive.7z # Detailed archive analysis
7za t *.7z -r # Verify integrity of all archives
7za x data.7z -o./extracted/ -y # Extract without prompts
